metadata.title: DocuVault — Your Documents, Safe. Found in Seconds.
metadata.description: No account, no servers. DocuVault scans your documents, reads them on your device, summarizes them with Apple Intelligence and reminds you before anything is due. Your documents stay in your own iCloud. For iPhone, in English and Turkish.
metadata.ogDescription: Scan, summarize, remind, store. Documents are read on your device, summarized by Apple Intelligence and stored only in your own iCloud.
metadata.twDescription: No account, no servers. On-device text recognition, Apple Intelligence summaries and due date reminders.

hero.subtitle: Scan it; DocuVault reads it on your device, summarizes it with Apple Intelligence and reminds you before it's due. No account to create, and your documents are stored only in your own iCloud.

features.subtitle: DocuVault 2.0 was rebuilt from the ground up with Apple technologies. DocuVault has no servers, no ads, no tracking and no analytics.

scanner.title: Scan and Auto-Fill
scanner.body: A multi-page scanner with automatic edge detection; add from Photos, Files or the Share menu. Text is read on your device, and the name, category, due date and amount fill in automatically.

aiSummary.title: Summaries with Apple Intelligence
aiSummary.body: A short summary and "Highlights" for every document: terms, amounts, dates. All on device; your documents are never sent to the internet.

askDocument.title: Ask Document
askDocument.body: Get answers to questions like "What's the deductible?" or "When does the contract end?" straight from the document. With Apple Intelligence, on your device.

reminders.title: Reminders and Spending
reminders.body: Notifications for payment due dates, policy expiry and warranties; add to Calendar with one tap. A monthly spending summary and upcoming payments from the amounts on your bills.

editing.title: Sign, Redact, Edit
editing.body: Sign documents with your finger. Find and permanently redact ID numbers, IBANs, card and phone numbers. Reorder, rotate and delete pages.

documentSets.title: Document Sets
documentSets.body: Ready-made lists for visas, renting a home, a new job, selling a car and tax periods; see what's missing at a glance. Create your own set with Apple Intelligence.

collections.title: Collections and Search
collections.body: Group documents in collections like "Home" or "Car". Search finds words in document names and even inside the documents themselves.

emergencyCard.title: Emergency Card
emergencyCard.body: Blood type, allergies, medications and emergency contacts on one card. From the Lock Screen widget and Siri, and on Apple Watch. The card is never sent to iCloud.

familyVault.title: Family Vault
familyVault.body: Share the documents you choose with your partner and family through iCloud sharing; invited members join for free. With Plus.

shareLinks.title: Encrypted Share Links
shareLinks.body: End-to-end encrypted, expiring links. The key lives only in the link; recipients open it in their browser without installing anything. With Plus.

backup.title: Encrypted Backup
backup.body: Back up your whole vault to a single password-encrypted file and keep it in Files, on your computer or on a USB drive.

shortcuts.title: Siri, Shortcuts and Widgets
shortcuts.body: Siri, Shortcuts, Visual Intelligence, Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, and Control Center buttons. In English and Turkish.

howItWorks.title: Document chaos ends in five steps.
howItWorks.subtitle: Scan, organize, summarize, find and store safely. All on your device.

scan.title: Scan or Add
scan.body: The built-in scanner finds the edges automatically and creates multi-page PDFs. You can also add from Photos, Files or the Share menu (Mail, WhatsApp, Safari).

organize.title: It Fills Itself In
organize.body: Text is read on your device; the name, category, due date and amount fill in automatically. Duplicate documents are detected.

summary.title: See the Summary, Ask the Document
summary.body: Apple Intelligence prepares a short summary and highlights for every document. Use Ask Document to get answers straight from the document.

find.title: Find It in Seconds
find.body: Search works on document names and the text inside them. Reach your documents by voice with Siri and Shortcuts, too.

secure.title: Store It Safely
secure.body: Your documents are stored only in your own iCloud account. With the Face ID / Touch ID lock and a password-encrypted backup file, you stay in control.

security.title: Your privacy is sacred to us.
security.subtitle: Your documents are among the most private parts of your life. That's why even we can't see them.

encryption.title: No account, no servers
encryption.body: No account, no email, no password. DocuVault has no servers holding your documents, and no ads, tracking or analytics.

residency.title: Only your iCloud
residency.body: Your documents, their recognized text and summaries are stored only in your own Apple iCloud account. Text recognition and Apple Intelligence run on your device; your documents are never sent to any server.

biometric.title: Face ID and encrypted sharing
biometric.body: Face ID / Touch ID lock, with content blurred in the app switcher. Share links are end-to-end encrypted and the key lives only in the link. Backup files are encrypted with your password.

faq.title: Answers up front.
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to common questions. For anything else, our support email is one click away.

items.a: Only in your own Apple iCloud account (CloudKit private database). DocuVault 2.0 has no servers holding your documents, and the DocuVault team can't access them. Deleting a document in the app also deletes it from iCloud.

items.q: Do I need to create an account?
items.a: No. DocuVault 2.0 has no account, email or password; download the app and start right away. Your documents sync through iCloud across iPhones signed in to the same Apple Account.

items.q: Does the AI send my documents to a server?
items.a: No. Text recognition happens on your device; summaries, "Highlights" and Ask Document run on Apple's on-device model (Apple Intelligence). Your documents are never sent to the internet or used for model training. Apple Intelligence features are available on iPhone 15 Pro and later.

A Document Set gathers everything a task needs (a visa application, renting a home, a new job, selling a car, a tax period) in one list and shows what's missing. Use a ready-made template or type something like "German student visa" to create your own with Apple Intelligence. The free plan includes 1 set and 1 AI try; Plus has unlimited sets.

items.q: Is my sensitive information protected when I share?
items.a: Yes. DocuVault finds ID numbers, IBANs, card and phone numbers automatically, and the fields you approve are permanently redacted. Share links created with Plus are end-to-end encrypted and expire; the key lives only in the link, and recipients open it in their browser without installing anything.

items.q: How does the Emergency Card work?
items.a: It keeps your blood type, allergies, medications and emergency contacts on one card. Reach it quickly from the Lock Screen widget and Siri, and see it on Apple Watch. The card is stored only on your device (and paired Apple Watch) and is never sent to iCloud.

items.q: What's in Plus, and what happens if it ends?
items.a: Plus unlocks unlimited documents, unlimited Ask Document, unlimited signatures, the Family Vault, encrypted share links, multiple reminder times and spending charts, and can be shared with your family through Family Sharing. If Plus ends, none of your documents get locked; only new additions beyond the free limits stop.

items.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
items.a: Manage or cancel it anytime from Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions on your iPhone. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

items.q: I used DocuVault 1.x. What happens to my documents?
items.a: Use the "Have you used DocuVault before?" card in your vault to sign in to your old account once and move your documents to 2.0. Moved documents are saved to your own iCloud.

items.q: How do I delete my data?
items.a: Deleting a document in the app also deletes it from iCloud. To remove all DocuVault data, go to iPhone Settings > [your name] > iCloud > Manage Storage > DocuVault. There is no account to delete.

items.q: When is the Android version coming?
items.a: DocuVault is built natively on Apple technologies (iCloud, Apple Intelligence, Face ID), so it's available for iPhone only. We have no plans for Android.
Yes. Scanning, text recognition, search, summaries and Ask Document all run on your device, so no internet is needed. iCloud sync, the Family Vault and share links work once you're connected.
